data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.question: interview
sections.summary: a formal meeting where someone is asked questions for a job or information

senses.definition: a formal meeting in which someone is asked questions to assess suitability for a job or to gather information
examples: She has a job interview tomorrow morning.

answers.answer: She has a job interview tomorrow morning.
She interviewed to the manager yesterday.
An interview is a driving permit.

sections.question: interviewer
sections.summary: a person who asks questions in an interview

senses.definition: a person who conducts an interview by asking questions
examples: The interviewer asked about her experience.

answers.answer: The interviewer asked about her experience.
The interviewer answered all the questions.
An interviewer is a written document.

sections.question: memoir
sections.summary: a book about someone’s personal experiences, written by that person

senses.definition: a written account of the author’s personal experiences, often focusing on a particular period of life
examples: He published a memoir about his time abroad.

answers.answer: He published a memoir about his time abroad.
He memoired his passport yesterday.
A memoir is a job position.

sections.question: passport
sections.summary: an official document that allows you to travel to other countries

senses.definition: an official government document that proves identity and citizenship and allows international travel

answers.answer: Her passport expires next year.
She passported through the airport quickly.
A passport is a school certificate.

sections.question: poll
sections.summary: a survey that collects people’s opinions

senses.definition: a survey of public opinion or a process of voting
examples: The poll showed strong public support.

answers.answer: The poll showed strong public support.
The poll asked him personally for a job.
A poll is a driving license.

sections.question: position
sections.summary: a job or role in a company or organisation

senses.definition: a job or role within an organisation or company
examples: She applied for a position in marketing.

answers.answer: She applied for a position in marketing.
She positioned for a marketing job.
A position is a type of survey.

sections.question: questionnaire
sections.summary: a written set of questions used to collect information

senses.definition: a document containing a list of questions used to gather information from people
examples: Please complete the questionnaire before leaving.

answers.answer: Please complete the questionnaire before leaving.
Please questionnaire your details carefully.
A questionnaire is a passport control officer.

sections.question: rank
sections.summary: a level or position in an organisation or group

senses.definition: a level or position in a hierarchy or organisation
examples: He reached the rank of manager after five years.

answers.answer: He reached the rank of manager after five years.
He ranked the company yesterday.
A rank is a personal autobiography.

sections.question: register
sections.summary: to officially record your name or details

senses.definition: to officially record information or sign up for something
examples: You must register before the deadline.

answers.answer: You must register before the deadline.
You must register your passport at home.
Register is another word for interview.

sections.question: registration
sections.summary: the act of officially recording your name or details

senses.definition: the process of officially recording information or signing up for something

answers.answer: Online registration closes tonight.
She registrationed for the course.
Registration is a biography.
